description:
I live in a 950 sq. ft. apartment, so you’d think I wouldn’t have to worry about spotty Wi-Fi quality. But my unit is “long” rather than “square,” and my cable connection comes into the unit at one of the far ends, so distance is an issue. I also have dense walls that prevent Wi-Fi penetration, so even the rooms near my router don’t get good signal. It’s a headache.

title: My home Wi-Fi was awful. These 6 fixes beat buying a new router
